player_prompt.intro:
Wewe ni Mchezaji {player_id}. Unacheza Memory Game.
Lengo lako ni kufanana na jozi nyingi za kadi kwenye bamba, zaidi ya mpinzani wako.
Kwenye mzunguko wako, chagua kadi mbili ili kuzipindua kwa kuandika nambari za safu na safu wima za kadi ya kwanza na ya pili mtawalia kama '[0 1 1 0]', ambapo kadi ya kwanza iko kwenye safu 0 na safu wima 1, na kadi ya pili iko kwenye safu 1 na safu wima 0.
Ikiwa kadi mbili zinafanana, unapata alama na kadi huachwa kuwa juu. Ikiwa hazifanani, kadi huinuliwa tena chini, kwa mfano '.'.
Mchezo huu unamaliza wakati jozi zote zimefanana.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Chinthu chambura kwenelera. Woseŵera {player_id} wakazgora na nthowa yakwenelera yayi mu vilembo vya makona ghanayi (square brackets).
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Mvuto usio halali. Mchezaji {player_id} wakhazikitsa malo ambapo siyofaa.
invalid_move.same_card_twice: Chinthu chambura kwenelera. Woseŵera {player_id} wasankha khadi limoza kaŵiri.
invalid_move.already_matched: Chinthu chambura kwenelera: Woseŵera {player_id} wasankha khadi limoza panji ghose ghaŵiri agho ghakumanyikwa kale.

game_message.cards_match: Kalata zosankhidwa ndi Mchezaji {player_id} pa malo a [{r1} {c1}] ndi [{r2} {c2}] zikwana!
game_message.cards_no_match: Kalata zosankhidwa ndi Mchezaji {player_id} zikugwana. Kalata pa malo a [{r1} {c1}] ndi [{r2} {c2}] ni {pos1} ndi {pos2} mtawali.

outcome.draw: Wachezaji wote wawili walipatana na idadi sawa ya jozi za kadi.
outcome.turn_limit: Mpaka wa zunguliro unafikwa. Mchezo unatha. Mchezaji 0 anapata alama {score_0}, Mchezaji 1 anapata alama {score_1}.
